files.README.md:
# Vellmoor Logistics - June 2026 subscription billing

Two billing systems raise subscription charges for the month.

invoices_utc.csv is the legacy invoicing system; its issued_at stamps are
recorded against UTC.

metering_sgt.csv is the usage-metering add-on; its recorded_at stamps are
recorded at UTC+08:00.

Together the two files hold every subscription charge for the period: a
charge appears in exactly one of them. Amounts are in US dollars.

Dates in both files are written day-first whenever the day and month are given
as bare numbers: an entry of 05/06/2026 or 05-06-2026 is 5 June 2026. Entries
that name the month in words, and year-first entries, are read as written.

ops/dispatch-notes.txt is the dispatch team's working note for the month.
